title: Elf Bar 600 Blueberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Compatible with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods offer a simple and sustainable way to enjoy consistently great flavour without the waste of single-use disposables. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying draw and rapid nicotine relief. Blueberry Flavour: A naturally sweet and juicy blueberry flavour, capturing the rich, full-bodied taste of ripe berries with just a hint of tartness. Smooth and well-balanced, this flavour is a great choice for berry lovers. Replacing pods is effortless—simply insert a fresh one and inhale. Whether you're switching from disposables or looking for a more practical way to vape, these prefilled pods ensure the same great Elf Bar experience in a convenient, replaceable format.
